skills.description: ERP Digital & AI Transformation Expert (Global / International-localization edition). A region-aware, single-skill system covering the full ERP domain — Procure (P2P), Supply (SCM), Sales (O2C), HR (HCM), Finance (R2R), Inventory/Asset, Integration Hub & MDM, and extended domains (MRP-MES/PS/QM/PM) — for every major market (US/EU-EEA/UK/DACH/FR/Nordics/JP/KR/SG/ANZ/CA/IN/BR/MX/GCC/SEA). Not a translation: each region's regulations, ERP ecosystem, tax, data-protection and financial-reporting standards are cited in native + English gloss. Ships four pillars (Cross-Reference Mesh, Retrieval-Driven Freshness, Rigor Gate G1–G12, Zero-Touch Self-Evolution Engine), a triple-gate pipeline (G1–G12 → DG1–DG6 → AI adversarial consensus gate), and pluggable region profiles so a newcomer can land a complex global ERP program and act like an expert.
